columns.name: product_id
columns.description: Stable openFDA product identifier (product NDC plus SPL id).

columns.name: product_type
columns.description: Product type (human prescription, OTC, vaccine, bulk ingredient...).

columns.name: application_number
columns.description: FDA application number, null if none.

columns.name: finished
columns.description: True for a finished drug product, false for bulk or further-processing material.

columns.name: marketing_end_date
columns.description: Marketing end date, YYYY-MM-DD, null if still marketed.

columns.name: dea_schedule
columns.description: DEA controlled-substance schedule, null if not scheduled.

columns.name: package_count
columns.description: Number of packages listed for the product.
